record_title: Strict singularity collapses to compactness for finite elementary operators on norm ideals
provenance: Two Calkin-space coefficient reductions applied to fixed rank-one column and row fibers force compact coefficients on both sides; finite-support norm-ideal slices are Hilbertian up to equivalent norm, and compact coefficients yield compact superoperators by finite-rank approximation.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The strict-singularity collapse and complemented rank-one witness are the claimed contribution. Fialkow-Loebl (1984) and older compact elementary-operator literature were not exhaustively inspected for an equivalent differently phrased statement; no independent novelty is claimed for every possible compact-coefficient characterization. The theorem is restricted to normalized Banach norm ideals of compact operators and finite elementary sums.
